name: Little x
tagline: Drive X and document tasks by email while you are away
description: Functions as an ops desk for the stretch of the day when you are nowhere near the app. Send a command by email and it drafts X replies, holds them for your approval before anything is posted, retrieves the files you request and pushes alerts to your phone. The market alerts are read-only, with no trading involved.
author: DonaldMoor91672
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
